text:
PSC::imsi
Description
The PSC::imsi command gets the imsi or sets the imsi when the optional
is given.
Syntax
PSC
::
imsi
PSC
::
imsi
<
value
>
PSC::imsi
retrieve the imsi value
PSC::imsi <value>
set the imsi value
